verdict.rationale: Summer Engine ships its own MCP server and CLI that external agents such as Claude Code or Codex can use. The docs say an agent can build, test and publish a game and can run the whole publishing flow through the MCP or CLI, which covers driving the project and triggering builds or publishing. The only MCP tools the evidence names are summer_docs_search and summer_docs_read; there is no documented tool for creating scenes or nodes or editing properties, and no API reference (OpenAPI probes returned 404). Missing for 10: documented scene/node creation and property-editing tools, a published tool/API reference for editor operations, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can drive the editor and project programmatically — create scenes and nodes, edit properties, trigger builds — through a documented scriptable interface

citations.quote: Bring Claude Code, Codex, Hermes or whatever agent you prefer, and it gets the same tools.
